name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Scratch Scrambled Egg & Turkey Sausage Breakfast Bowl
whyItWorks: Thomas Cuisine's real-food scratch kitchen standard! Fresh cage-free scrambled eggs, lean turkey sausage crumbles, and well-steamed diced potatoes with light cheddar. Soft, zero-roughage corporate fuel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Morning Scramble Bowl with scrambled eggs, turkey sausage, and breakfast potatoes (hold salsa and jalapeños).
